company.name: Adaptive Security
company.shortDescription: Adaptive Security provides training and phishing simulations to help organizations strengthen human defenses against evolving cyber threats.
company.description: Adaptive Security provides a platform focused on security awareness training and simulated AI-driven cyber attacks to help organizations strengthen human defenses against evolving threats. It offers interactive training modules on topics such as deepfakes, smishing, and AI-generated attacks, and enables organizations to tailor content with an AI content creator for role-specific learning. The platform also runs multi-channel phishing simulations using customizable AI personas and real-world intelligence to mirror actual attack patterns. Additionally, it delivers risk monitoring features that quantify individual and organizational threat exposure and supports automated risk-based remediation workflows. This suite helps security teams assess and improve employee readiness against advanced cyber threats.
